rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken term for a hair growing along the edge of the eyelid.

example.english: My eyelash fell onto my face.
example.traditional: 我條眼睫毛跌咗落塊面度。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tiu4 ngaan5 zit3 mou4 dit3 zo2 lok6 faai3 min6 dou6

rows.note: Use this shorter equivalent when the context already makes clear that the hair is on the eye.

example.english: Dust got stuck in my eyelash.
example.traditional: 我隻眼入咗塵，黐住條睫毛。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 ngaan5 jap6 zo2 can4 ci1 zyu6 tiu4 zit6 mou4

rows.note: This is a colloquial shortened form used for the same eyelid hair.

example.jyutping: nei5 tiu4 ngaan5 mou4 hou2 coeng4 wo3
